description: Erection of a rear roof extension; erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing back addition; and installation of 2no. rooflights in the front roof slope to replace 2no. existing rooflights.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Roof Pod extension: Natural or artificial grey/black slates which shall match the colour, shape and size of the existing roof extension.

- Windows: Timber frames, colour, style, detail and finish to match the existing.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - No part of any roof of the rear roof pod extension hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roof(s). No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roof(s), and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto the roof(s). 

The use of the roof as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking, noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11 and CC11 of the Local Plan (2018).
